_meta.method: the host CLI agent (an LLM) read each record's live PubMed abstract or live ClinicalTrials.gov summary and applied the pre-registered eligibility criteria; no separate API key — the orchestrating agent is the model
_meta.criteria: Include if: randomised, placebo-controlled; heart failure is the index condition (any EF); SGLT2 inhibitor vs placebo; reports a hazard ratio for the primary HF composite. Exclude if: population is T2D/CKD without HF as index condition; non-randomised; secondary/subgroup report of an included trial; no primary HF composite HR.

NCT03036124.reason: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; heart failure (reduced EF) is the index condition; dapagliflozin vs placebo; the abstract reports the primary composite of worsening HF or CV death with a hazard ratio — meets every criterion.

NCT03057977.reason: Randomised, placebo-controlled HFrEF trial; empagliflozin vs placebo; abstract reports the primary composite of CV death or HF hospitalisation as a hazard ratio — eligible.

NCT03057951.reason: Randomised, placebo-controlled trial in heart failure with preserved EF; empagliflozin vs placebo; primary HF composite reported as a hazard ratio — eligible across the EF spectrum per the protocol.

NCT03619213.reason: Randomised, placebo-controlled trial in HF with mildly reduced or preserved EF; dapagliflozin vs placebo; primary composite of worsening HF or CV death reported — eligible.

NCT03521934.reason: Randomised, placebo-controlled trial in patients hospitalised for worsening heart failure; sotagliflozin vs placebo; reports an HF composite hazard ratio. Diabetes is an entry criterion and sotagliflozin is a dual SGLT1/2 inhibitor, but heart failure is the index condition — eligible (lower confidence flagged for reviewer attention).

DAPA-CKD.reason: Population is chronic kidney disease, not heart failure; the primary outcome is a renal composite and HF events are secondary — fails the population and primary-outcome criteria.

EMPA-KIDNEY.reason: Chronic kidney disease population; the primary outcome is kidney-disease progression or CV death, with no primary HF composite hazard ratio — fails the population and outcome criteria.

DECLARE-TIMI 58.reason: Population is type 2 diabetes with or at risk of atherosclerotic disease; HF hospitalisation is a secondary outcome, not the primary HF composite — fails the population criterion.

EMPA-REG OUTCOME.reason: Population is type 2 diabetes with established cardiovascular disease; primary outcome is 3-point MACE and heart failure was exploratory — not a heart-failure trial.

CANVAS Program.reason: Live ClinicalTrials.gov record: type 2 diabetes with high cardiovascular risk; primary outcome is 3-point MACE, not the HF composite — fails the population and outcome criteria.

SCORED.reason: Live ClinicalTrials.gov record: population is type 2 diabetes with chronic kidney disease. Its primary composite does include HF hospitalisations and urgent visits, but heart failure is not the index condition, so it fails the population criterion — borderline, flagged for reviewer attention.

DAPA-HF diabetes subgroup.reason: Pre-specified subgroup/secondary publication of an already-included trial (DAPA-HF), reporting on the same randomised population — including it would double-count participants.

Observational SGLT2i HF cohort.reason: Non-randomised (retrospective registry cohort) design; the eligibility criteria require a randomised controlled trial — excluded as out of design scope.
